Kokapet: common questions

What is the price per sq.ft in Kokapet, Hyderabad?

Residential prices in the Kokapet & Neopolis corridor are roughly ₹9,000–15,000/sqft (indicative, mid-2026 market reports). Outlook: 10–15% / yr.

Which new projects are available in Kokapet?

Pristinia by Rajapushpa Properties (2, 3, 4 BHK, ₹1.8 Cr onwards); Beaumonde by Koncept Ambience (3 BHK, ₹1.9 Cr onwards); One by Navanaami Projects (3.5, 4 BHK, ₹2.1 Cr onwards).

Is Kokapet a good place to buy property?

Hyderabad's "Next Gachibowli". Financial District overflow, the Neopolis SEZ and direct ORR access have made this the city's most premium western corridor.
